test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing the north.

Only two people sit to the left of A. Only three people sit between A and G. D sits second to the right of A. Only two people sit between D and C. E sits at some place to the right of F but at some place to the left of B.

How many people sit to the right of C?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing the north.

1. Only two people sit to the left of A.

2. Only three people sit between A and G.

3. D sits second to the right of A.

4. Only two people sit between D and C.

5. E sits at some place to the right of F but at some place to the left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22fe4b41a3bfb20449b30aafd12fcf37d3c2066239bc921bfe169c43c5eea52a.png] 

Thus, 5 people sit to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
